  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c-html.c","function":"md_html","line":533,"var":"parser","code":"MD_PARSER parser = { ... parser_flags, enter_block_callback, leave_block_callback, enter_span_callback, leave_span_callback, text_callback, debug_log_callback, NULL };","note":"The attacker-controlled parser flags are copied into the parser configuration that drives parsing and rendering callbacks."},

  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c.c","function":"build_attribute","line":1467,"var":"build->substr_offsets","code":"build->substr_offsets[build->substr_count] = off;","note":"The parser records substring boundaries for the attribute, creating a sequence of spans that the renderer later iterates over."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c-html.c","function":"render_attribute","line":254,"var":"attr->substr_offsets[i]","code":"for(i = 0; attr->substr_offsets[i] < attr->size; i++) {","note":"The renderer walks the attacker-influenced substring table to emit each piece of the attribute value."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c-html.c","function":"render_attribute","line":257,"var":"size","code":"MD_SIZE size = attr->substr_offsets[i+1] - off;","note":"Each substring length is derived from adjacent offsets; malformed or extreme span layouts can drive incorrect size calculations."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c-html.c","function":"render_entity","line":188,"var":"codepoint","code":"for(i = 3; i < size-1; i++) codepoint = 16 * codepoint + hex_val(text[i]);","note":"When a substring is parsed as a numeric entity, attacker-controlled digits are accumulated into a codepoint value."},
  {"step":11,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c-html.c","function":"render_utf8_codepoint","line":170,"var":"utf8","code":"fn_append(r, (char*)utf8, n);","note":"The computed codepoint is converted to UTF-8 bytes and appended to the output buffer through the callback."},
  {"step":12,"file":"src-vul/md4c/test/fuzzers/fuzz-mdhtml.c","function":"process_output","line":7,"var":"out","code":"static void process_output(...) { return; }","note":"The harness discards output, so the crash must occur inside parsing/rendering before the callback returns."}
